en: That man was no customer. He was a lookout for Team Rocket, keeping watch on whoever comes in.
This shop is their front. The signal driving the lake's Magikarp to rage comes from right under our feet.
H-hey! Customers stay this side of the counter!
Stairs, hidden behind the counter. Just as I thought.
{player}, I'm going down. Follow me when you're ready, and keep your guard up.
Welcome, welcome! Rage Candy Bars, fresh today. Well... nearly fresh.
Nothing back there but stock. Customers stay this side of the counter!
I-I don't know anything about any stairs! I just work the till, honest!
I stop in here every time I pass through. Something about this place always feels a little off.
Ow... That Dragonite packs a wallop. Me, a lookout? I'm just here for the sweets!
Something about this shop doesn't sit right with me.
